name: Marco Ruggiero
abstract_title: Mind-Matter Interactions in Buddhist Practice: Measurable Variations in Natural Radioactivity and the Concept of Enlightenment (Buddhahood) as Actual Proof
abstract: This observational study explores a potential correlation between the chanting of Nam-Myoho-Renge-Kyo (Daimoku), the central prayer of Nichiren Shoshu Buddhism, and subtle variations in the surrounding natural radioactivity. The investigation fits within the context of research on mind-matter interactions (such as the PEAR and Global Consciousness Project studies), proposing an analysis of how a profound and focused psycho-physiological state can influence random physical systems.
